import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}work-flows`;// Get Data
const getWorkflows=async()=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL);return response.data;};// Create 
const createWorkflow=async workflowData=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,workflowData);return response.data;};// update
const updateWorkflow=async(workflowId,workflowData)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+'/'+workflowId,workflowData);return response.data;};// Delete 
const deleteWorkflow=async workflowId=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+'/'+workflowId);return response.data;};const workflowService={getWorkflows,createWorkflow,updateWorkflow,deleteWorkflow};export default workflowService;
